intro: Scholars come to the Royal Library in Stormwind Keep for the kingdom’s records and histories. Head Librarian Milton Sheaf watches over its scrolls and treatises, from ancient wars to accounts of realms beyond the sea.

p: The Royal Library offers quiet among Stormwind Keep’s guarded halls and courtly intrigues. Milton Sheaf oversees its shelves of southern human history, from surviving texts written before the First War to recent military chronicles and recovered tomes. Alliance scholars, priests, and travelers may browse its treatises. They cover the founding of the Alliance of Lordaeron and the recent arrival of Thrall’s Horde in Kalimdor.
